notice: Team event hypotheses, not verified legal findings. Person C must verify citations before submission. Missing actions cannot be proved from sparse frames.

rules.title: Откладывание части наличных отдельно
rules.criteria: Cashier visibly moves part of received cash to a clearly personal location, then returns or processes the remainder. Ordinary sorting into desk piles is insufficient. Do not claim theft or intent.

rules.title: Приём наличных без видимой проверки документа
rules.criteria: A cash acceptance sequence occurs without a document check observed. Missing a document in sampled frames cannot establish that no check happened.

rules.title: Наличные предыдущего клиента при приёме следующего
rules.criteria: The sequence clearly establishes a first customer's cash remains on the counter when a different customer begins a transaction. Do not infer cash ownership from a single image.

rules.title: Уход с рабочего места при открытом ноутбуке
rules.criteria: Cashier leaves the work area while the laptop remains visibly open. State only the visible lid/screen condition; never infer that the session is unlocked or that a computer must be shut down.

rules.title: Помещение наличных в сейф без видимого пересчёта
rules.criteria: Cash moves from an envelope into the safe. Lack of a counting action in sampled pictures is insufficient evidence that counting was omitted.

rules.title: Оставление конверта на столе при уходе
rules.criteria: Cashier visibly exits the work area leaving an envelope on the desk. Both the exit and remaining envelope must be visible. Do not assume the contents.

rules.title: Уход клиента до видимой проверки конверта
rules.criteria: Customer hands over an envelope and leaves; no contents inspection is observed. Sparse sampling cannot prove that inspection never occurred.

rules.title: Одновременное обслуживание двух клиентов
rules.criteria: Cashier visibly continues processing one customer's transaction while beginning another customer's transaction. Mere presence of two people is insufficient.

rules.title: Оставление сейфа открытым
rules.criteria: Safe door is clearly open and cashier visibly moves away to other work or exits without closing it. A safe opened while actively accessing its contents is normal.

rules.title: Оставление ключа в замке сейфа при уходе
rules.criteria: A key is clearly distinguishable in the safe lock while cashier exits the work area. Do not guess the presence of a tiny key from a blurred mark.

rules.title: Извлечение ключа при открытом сейфе
rules.criteria: Key removal is visible while safe door remains clearly open. Inability to see the locking action does not establish an unlocked safe.

rules.title: Оставление наличных на столе при уходе
rules.criteria: Clearly identifiable banknotes remain on the desk after the cashier visibly leaves the work area. Moving to a nearby safe during active work is not by itself an exit.

rules.title: Вход посетителя в рабочую зону кассира
rules.criteria: A person clearly established as a visitor or customer crosses into the cashier's restricted side. Cashier entering or leaving, or an unidentified colleague, is insufficient. Do not infer authorization.

rules.title: Оставление двери открытой
rules.criteria: Cashier visibly enters or exits through the access door, and that door remains clearly open over several later frames after the passage is finished. Distinguish a door from the customer window.

rules.title: Уход клиента до завершения проверки наличных
rules.criteria: The same customer who handed over cash visibly leaves while the cashier is still visibly counting that cash. No assumption about unseen previous counting.

rules.title: Размещение наличных на открытой поверхности стола
rules.criteria: Banknotes placed on an ordinary working surface; this action alone does not establish a violation without a verified applicable requirement.

rules.title: Размещение личных вещей на рабочем столе
rules.criteria: A bag or coat is clearly placed on the cash-processing desk. A bag on the floor or a coat worn by a person does not qualify.

rules.title: Смешивание банкнот разных номиналов
rules.criteria: Distinct denominations are legible and are visibly combined into one pile. Different colors alone are insufficient; whether sorting is obligatory needs a verified rule.

rules.title: Размещение напитка рядом с наличными
rules.criteria: A drink container is clearly on the working surface immediately beside identifiable banknotes. A drink elsewhere in the room does not qualify.

rules.title: Объединение наличных разных клиентов
rules.criteria: A sequence establishes different customer origins and clearly shows their banknotes being combined into one pile. Cash ownership must not be guessed.

rules.title: Наличные разных клиентов без видимого разделения
rules.criteria: Different customers' cash is placed nearby without a divider. Ownership and any required separation must be established; proximity alone is insufficient.
